message:
Running Python code interactively: data = open('/tmp/testcase.exr','rb').read()
off = 8
attrs = []
while True:
    end = data.index(b'\x00', off)
    name = data[off:end].decode('ascii', errors='replace')
    off = end + 1
    end = data.index(b'\x00', off)
    typ = data[off:end].decode('ascii', errors='replace')
    off = end + 1
    size = int.from_bytes(data[off:off+4], 'little')
    off += 4
    val = data[off:off+size]
    attrs.append((name, typ, size, off))
    off += size
    print(f"name={name!r} type={typ!r} size={size} value_offset={off-size} value_len={len(val)}")
    if name == '':
        break
    if off >= len(data):
        print("Reached end of file while parsing header")
        break
print("Final offset:", off)
